newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Four dead in Medellin cab, gunmen slay three others.
newsitem.headline: Four dead in Medellin cab, gunmen slay three others.

text.p: Unidentified assassins killed seven people in two separate attacks in the notoriously-violent northwest Colombian city of Medellin, police said on Sunday.
Three men and a woman were found dead in the back of a taxi late on Saturday evening in a western district of the city, Colombia's third largest.
A police spokesman said the four were bound hand and foot and had been tortured before being strangled.
Two men and a 16-year-old boy were shot to death by suspected urban guerrillas in an eastern suburb of Medellin early on Sunday. A fourth man was injured, the police spokesman said.
Medellin with a population of about 1.5 million has one of the highest murder rates in the world. Last year more than 5,000 people were murdered there.
